classification_legend: blocked by unavailable observations or metadata

findings.hypothesis: temporal mismatch alone explains low AP
evidence: Seven of eight selected 24h/48h observations precede the nominal model horizon by 10.28 to 35.23 hours; the remaining gap is 0.63 hours.
All eight AP calls are losses/tie versus the frozen baseline, including the 0.63-hour-gap E2024-131853 24h cell (AP delta -0.070).
No approved maximum-age threshold exists; timestamp mismatch is established, its causal contribution is not isolated.
findings.cannot_conclude: The near-aligned loss and other mismatches show temporal lag cannot be asserted as the sole explanation; they do not prove lag has no effect.

findings.hypothesis: target semantics mismatch matters independently of temporal lag
evidence: Labels are cumulative VIIRS nominal/high active-fire detection cells, not a complete burned-perimeter mask.
VIIRS CSVs have no per-cell clear-sky/valid-view coverage mask; Boolean target arrays encode every other cell as false.
The observation mask is mapped from nominal 375m keys onto a 30m simulation grid; this is a coarse detection-cell assignment, not a measured 30m perimeter.
Direct descriptive centroid/support discrepancies are present in the per-incident diagnostics, but are not interpretable as physical perimeter error.
findings.consequence: Official AP/Brier are reproducible against the stated historical target but do not validate physical burned-area spread or trustworthy fire absence.

findings.hypothesis: DMM onset error is being scored as Cell2Fire spread error
evidence: Each simulation starts from a prescribed coordinate in protocol_setup.json with per-member jitter; no DMM prediction output is passed to run_dev.
No DMM-to-Cell2Fire bridge or DMM predicted onset record is in these saved artifacts.
The simulation is conditional on its prescribed ignition. Ignition-to-target mismatch therefore affects interpretation/initial-condition alignment, but is not an observed DMM model error.
findings.observed_discrepancy: The prescribed ignition cell is absent from both selected E2024-135332 positive masks and present in the other six scored masks.

findings.hypothesis: saved simulated footprints are small, grow over time, and vary across members
evidence: All 60-member archives have exact 6/12/24/48 frames and pass manifest SHA-256 checks.

Per-frame member burned-cell distributions, physical area conversions (900m2/cell), centroid offsets, boundary contact, mask diversity, cellwise member disagreement, and adjacent-frame IoU/new/lost counts are in footprint_descriptives.json.
No burned cells are lost between consecutive saved frames in any member; three E2024-135332 members touch the domain edge at 48h; the remaining members do not touch an edge.
Every 24h/48h score comparison has descriptive spatial support/centroid values in per_incident_diagnostics.json.
findings.causality: These properties correlate with observed score patterns but do not establish why a score is low.

findings.hypothesis: wind convention or grid orientation is wrong
findings.classification: blocked by unavailable observations or metadata
evidence: The existing verified synthetic cardinal-wind artifact reports all four expected downwind half-planes, north-up row orientation, and deterministic repeats.
The completed wind test is reused; it was not rerun.
findings.limitation: The synthetic convention-specific reversal hypothesis is ruled out by that test; whether historical real-case wind/terrain/fuel explains error is blocked by input/member provenance and observational evidence.

findings.hypothesis: ignition indexing, horizon selection, or seeded jitter defects affected prior results
evidence: Prior reproducibility audit documents a jitter-index selection mismatch and a prior horizon-frame substitution; current archived run metadata records exact source frames 6/12/24/48.
All 240 current member archives pass SHA-256 and exact-frame checks in this analysis.
findings.remaining_risk: Archived manifests omit ignition_jitter_radius_m and per-member wind perturbation parameters; current run_dev.py and rescore_fair.py hashes differ from the hashes recorded in recovery_provenance.json. Exact historical source/member-input replay remains incomplete.

findings.hypothesis: fuel, terrain, weather-window or ROS input defect is the established cause
findings.classification: blocked by unavailable observations or metadata
evidence: Source code/audits document the WorldCover-to-fuel crosswalk, DEM-derived slope, cached ERA5-Land hourly wind and ROS threshold.
The current cardinal direction test validates convention, not incident-specific input accuracy.
The exact historical run source hashes and member-specific weather perturbations do not fully match/reappear in current archived provenance.
findings.cannot_conclude: No specific fuel/terrain/weather defect was confirmed or ruled out by saved probability grids alone.

findings.hypothesis: physical spread accuracy can be inferred from local observations
findings.classification: blocked by unavailable observations or metadata
evidence: Local MCD64A1 is monthly/coarse and has burn-date uncertainty up to six days among in-domain positive pixels; E2024-135332 tile extent is incomplete.
VIIRS is active-fire detection data and has no valid-observation coverage mask.
No local time-resolved independent perimeter was found in the scoped inventory.
findings.needed: Independent time-stamped perimeter/progression observations, quality/coverage masks, and owner-approved timing/spatial/unknown-cell protocol.

findings.hypothesis: current fair-rescore command reproduces archived benchmark end-to-end
evidence: One invocation of rescore_fair.py --member-grid-dir ... was blocked before scoring because the archived per-member manifest lacks ignition_jitter_radius_m, which the current CLI requires.

Direct calls to the same module's score and blurred_baseline helpers recomputed all six AP/Brier values for each of eight cells from saved members, current selected VIIRS masks, and local cached wind; every value matched the hash-recorded official reproduction within 1e-12.
Recomputed calls remain 0 wins, 1 tie, 7 losses.
findings.policy: No source code was changed to bypass the guard; the mismatch is recorded for a separate artifact-contract repair.

ruled_out_or_not_supported: No direct evidence that the synthetic cardinal wind direction or north-up raster orientation is reversed.
No inference that non-detected VIIRS cells were observed-unburned.
No evidence that DMM predictions were inputs to these conditional simulations.
No verified basis to call local MCD64A1 an exact 24h/48h perimeter reference.
